Unlike the singles titles, the tag team titles changed hands very often when the promotion toured outside the state of Georgia, as far away as Alabama and Tennessee.

Homicide (wrestler) | Nelson Rodriguez Erazo (born March 20, 1977) is an American professional wrestler, better known by his ring name, Homicide.
